Lina Q: quick design q — we keep hitting tie cases when 2+ SIs match HW SKU capabilities. do we prefer a deterministic rotation (fairness) or a capability-weighted tiebreak? need a proposal for the vendor sync.
Harold W: rotation reduces bias over time. capability-weighted helps prioritize partners that actually do installs. propose hybrid: rotation baseline, bump score when partner has verified SKU installs.
Priya S: +1 hybrid. also we should canonicalize SKU mapping in the marketplace so routing can match exact install-experience tags (e.g., sku:edge-rack-v2 -> tags: onprem, requires-site-survey). prevents false matches.
Jamal K: what about a "rotation-seed" that's tied to partner on-call week so ops can predict who handles rapid claims? keeps load balanced and transparent.
ops-bot: Claim created: "AstraGrid" -> broker_queue. claim_id=CLM-4412. notified: #partnerships @ops-team :robot_face:
Lina Q: drafted scoring idea: base_score = rotation_score (0..100). capability_bonus = 50 if partner.has_verified_sku. recency_penalty = -30 if partner accepted >3 similar deals in last 7d. total_score = base + bonus + penalty. highest wins.
Harold W: sample pseudo:
```yaml
# tiebreak prototype
for interested_partner in partners:
  score = partners.rotation_rank * 10
  if partner.has_verified_install(sku):
    score += 50
  if partner.accepted_similar_in_last(7d) > 3:
    score -= 30
select partner with max(score)
if tie:
  pick next in rotation
```
Priya S: canonical SKU mapping notes:
- marketplace SKUs must include vendor_sku, compatibility_tags (onprem, requires_network, rtp_support), and validated_partners list
- routing uses compatibility_tags + validated_partners for auto-claim; otherwise falls to broker flow
marketplace-bot: SKU mapping update: sku=edge-rack-v2 added compatibility_tags=[onprem,site-survey] validated_partners=[OrionSI,NorthPeak] :gear:
Jamal K: ops note: ensure rotation_rank is deterministic and auditable. store weekly rotation snapshot in claim metadata. also expose a "why" field on decisions for transparency to partners and AEs.
Lina Q: agree — decision transparency reduces partner churn. can we include a one-line reason in DM like: "Assigned to OrionSI (verified install, rotation_rank=2, score=72)"?
Harold W: yes. also add a fallback: if selected partner rejects within 24h, auto-assign to next-highest and notify AE + partners.
Priya S: small edge-case: multiple partners with verified installs but different geographic coverage. add geo-match as multiplier (e.g., +20 for same region).
ops-bot: Action: create RFC for tiebreak + SKU canonicalization and pilot with 4 SKUs. ticket=OPS-1187. reminder ping @LinaQ in 48h. :white_check_mark:
Lina Q: i'll draft the RFC today and include examples, sample DM text, and a tiny state diagram for the pilot. thanks everyone.
Jamal K: i'll compile partner capability matrix for the SKUs we plan to pilot.
Harold W: i'll add rotation engine sketch and a quick audit endpoint in the routing service. opening PR tomorrow.
Priya S: i'll prepare the SKU canonicalization checklist and a short partner-facing doc explaining why mapping matters (reduces noisy claims).
Lina Q: perfect — vendor sync on Fri will get the draft. :rocket:
